Property.name: TargetConfigNames
Property.Description: Configuration item(s) to which to send stream messages

Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC=$$$OK $$$LOGINFO("OnProcessInput, got message of size " _ pInput.Stream.Size) Do pInput.Stream.Rewind() set pDoc = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Message).ImportFromLibraryStream(pInput.Stream, tSC)
Set tSC=..resolveAndIndex(pDoc) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC $$$LOGINFO("Sending HL7 Message "_pDoc_" / "_pDoc.%Id()_" from "_pDoc.Source) For iTarget=1:1:$L(..TargetConfigNames, ",") { Set tOneTarget=$ZStrip($P(..TargetConfigNames,",",iTarget),"<>W") Continue:""=tOneTarget
$$$LOGINFO("Send msg to " _ tOneTarget) Set tSC1=..SendRequestAsync(tOneTarget,pDoc) Set:$$$ISERR(tSC1) tSC=$$$ADDSC(tSC,tSC1) }
Quit tSC
